avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces clobazam levels and seizure control efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and potential hepatotoxicity concerns with benzodiazepines
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use with clobazam

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation or dizziness; dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; educate patient on sedation risk

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase clobazam levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased drowsiness or adverse effects

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Significant additive CNS depression, impaired cognition, respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Strongly advise patient to avoid alcohol entirely during clobazam therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and affect peak drug levels
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent timing

monitoring_notes: Monitor seizure control, CNS depression symptoms, and liver function periodically. Counsel patients to avoid alcohol and CNS depressants, and report excessive sedation or breakthrough seizures.
